summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K providing routine updates on its at-the-market offering program (no shares sold), share repurchase program (no shares purchased), bitcoin holdings (sold 3,588 BTC for $216M to fund preferred stock distributions and replenish USD reserve), and USD reserve status. No board recommendation or advisors are named. This is a standard periodic disclosure of operational and treasury activities, not a special situation event. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. What to watch: continued bitcoin sales may pressure MSTR stock if BTC price falls.
